import html from typing import List # Template for rendering a user post. The placeholders will be filled using str.format. USER_POST_FORMAT: str = ( "
\n" "

{post_title}

\n" "

Posted by: {username}

\n" "
{post_body}
\n" "
{tags_html}
\n" "
" ) def _escape_and_strip(value: str) -> str: """ Escape HTML special characters and strip leading/trailing whitespace. """ return html.escape(value.strip(), quote=True) def render_user_post( username: str, post_title: str, post_body: str, tags: List[str] ) -> str: """ Render a user-generated post as safe HTML. Parameters ---------- username : str Name of the user who created the post. post_title : str Title of the post. post_body : str Main content of the post. tags : list[str] List of tags added by the user. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string representing the post. Notes ----- * All user-supplied content is escaped to prevent XSS (CWE-79). * Tags are rendered as elements; each tag is individually escaped. """ # Sanitize user inputs safe_username = _escape_and_strip(username) safe_title = _escape_and_strip(post_title) safe_body = _escape_and_strip(post_body) # Sanitize tags and render as elements safe_tags = [ f'{_escape_and_strip(tag)}' for tag in tags ] tags_html = " ".join(safe_tags) # Construct the final HTML using the template rendered = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, post_title=safe_title, post_body=safe_body, tags_html=tags_html ) return rendered
